This application, under Section 438 Cr.P.C. is preferred by the applicant, namely, Partha Pratim Bujarbaruah, who has been apprehending arrest in connection Page No.# 2/4 with Dispur P. S. Case No. 266/2023, u/s 420/406 IPC, for grant of pre-arrest bail.

sentences.text:
The essence of allegation made in the FIR dated 8.2.2023, is that the informant has advanced a sum of Rs.72,500/- by way of cheque towards advance payment of Rs.1,45,000/- for purchasing Automatic Boom Barrier, IP based access controller, UHF Reader, Cables and Connectors,
installation and Configuration, Mtr Galvanized Pole and UHF-1 TAG4 for the site "Protech Galaxy".
The cheque was encased and the amount was debited from his account on 17.8.2021.

But, the applicant has failed to supply the aforesaid articles, for which he has withdrawn the order on 7.9.2021 and thereafter, the applicant has issued a cheque, amounting to Rs.72,500/-, on 25.9.2021.
But the said cheque was dishonoured and returned unpaid on 30.9.2021, on account of insufficiency of fund.

Mr. Chakraborty, learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant, as ordered by the informant, has placed the order for supplying the articles and the same was in transit, but on 7.9.2021, the informant has cancelled the order and thereafter, the applicant with a view to return the amount of Rs. 72,500/- has issued a cheque, but, unfortunately the cheque was dishonoured and that the dispute is civil in nature and appropriate remedy is available but instead of availing the same, the informant has lodged the FIR with mala-fide intention and that applicant is ready to cooperate with the investigating agency and therefore, it is contended to allow the petition.
Page No.# 3/4 On the other hand, Mr. K.K.Parasar, learned Addl. P.P. submits that appropriate remedy for dishonor of cheque is available to the informant under N.I.Act, but without availing the aforesaid remedy, the informant has lodged this criminal complaint against the applicant.
Having heard the submission of learned Advocates of both sides, and also considering the nature of accusation, perusal of the case diary is found to be necessary, and accordingly, it is provided that the learned Addl. P.P. shall produce the case diary before this Court on 1.12.2023.
In the interim, considering the submission of learned Counsel for both sides and also considering the facts and circumstances on record, this court is inclined to extend interim protection to the applicant, till receipt of the case diary.

Accordingly, it is provided that in the event of arrest of the applicant, in connection with Dispur P. S. Case No. 266/2023, u/s 420/406 IPC, he shall be released on interim pre arrest bail, on his executing a bond of Rs.50,000/ with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.

That the applicant shall not leave the jurisdiction of the learned CJM, Kamrup(M)
without prior permission.
